stem: Material enters storage with uneven internal moisture even though outer surfaces feel dry. What is the strongest response?
choices: Reassess product condition and moisture equilibration before long-term sealed storage rather than relying on surface feel alone
Seal permanently because the surface is dry
Increase storage temperature to force faster stabilization
Judge the whole batch from one small flower
rationale: Representative product-condition checks are stronger than surface feel alone when deciding whether material is ready for storage.
